query: Re-issue of ordinary passport of 36 pages in lieu of lost, stolen or damaged passport
expected_key_facts: On the government online application, select 'Passport Re-issue' and mark the reason as lost or damage as applicable, and choose the correct jurisdiction.
Under 'Type of passport booklet' on the online application, select '36 pages' (or '60 pages' for a jumbo booklet, at additional charge).
For a lost/stolen passport, a detailed, approved police report (not older than 6 months) naming the applicant and referencing the lost passport must be submitted.
VFS online registration must be completed before the physical application is mailed; the completed checklist and required documents are then sent by mail to the VFS India Consular Application Centre.

query: I lost my passport, I want to reapply my passport. I have travel to india in december 15. Can I take an inperson appointment to reapply for my lost passport.
expected_key_facts: The reissue-in-lieu-of-lost process is completed via VFS online registration followed by mailing the completed application, checklist, and documents to the VFS India Consular Application Centre.
On the government online application, select 'Passport Re-issue' and mark the reason as 'lost'.
A detailed, approved police report (not older than 6 months) naming the applicant and describing how the passport was lost must be included.
Once the mailed application is delivered to the VFS Consular Application Centre, the status is updated within 48-72 business hours and can be tracked online.

query: I have applied for the reissue if passport since i have lost my passport, so i had submitted the required documents that are need for passport application ,how many days it gonna take to get my passport or what's the further process
expected_key_facts: After your documents are delivered to the VFS India Consular Application Centre, the application status is updated within 48-72 business hours and can be tracked online.
If any required document is missing, the application is put 'on Hold' with an email notification, and you must supply the missing document within 7 days of that notification.
If the missing documents are not received, the application is Abandoned after 21 days and the entire process must be restarted with a new (voided) application.
The consulate/VFS reserves the right to call for additional documents as considered necessary.

query: I lost my passport in a house fire in Miami but I am relocating to Boston for a few weeks to live with family, where should I file my lost passport query
expected_key_facts: You should select the correct Indian mission/consulate based on where you reside in the USA; mission jurisdiction can be checked online at the VFS jurisdiction page.

If staying temporarily with family and lacking your own permanent address proof, a notarized undertaking from the relatives you are staying with (along with a notarized copy of their address proof) can be submitted, or a notarized hotel bill if in temporary lodging.

query: what documents are required for notarization if passport is lost
expected_key_facts: The Affidavit for Change of Appearance & Signature must be signed by the applicant and notarized (with notary stamp and signature); it is mandatory for all applicants.
The copy of valid US legal status (e.g., Green Card, visa, EAD, I-797A Approval Notice, work/study permit) must be submitted as a notarized color copy.

If you don't have permanent address proof and reside with parents/children/siblings, a notarized undertaking from them plus a notarized copy of their address proof is required; those in a hotel/temporary lodging can instead submit a notarized hotel bill.
The notary stamp's expiry date must not be manually corrected or overwritten.
